collection.title: Vauxhall Vectra Hatchback 1995 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Vectra Hatchback 1995 to 2002 requires a 19" wiper blade on both the drivers side and for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Vectra which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
